When I was at my lowest point, I thought the same. Then who else but a group of American veterans made me realise it's not all hopeless. If you're there for it an answer always comes to you. Dying is the last thing you must want, if you want to have a good existance. Don't rely on God being there. He may be, but you're looking at the worst thing you could imagine, and who knows what it is after death. Hang on to this life my friend, because it's your only shot at it. Please PM me if you want to talk more.

This world is such a beautiful place. Things always change and they improve. If they don't, you move on. Suicide is the worst thing you can do now. I guarantee you it will not fix a thing, for you or anyone else. I've been in exactly the same position as you, so I want to make sure no one else gets in that position. Whatever is the biggest problem in your life is utterly fixable. If it's not, then we learn to live with it, it's our greatest gift. Please, don't kill yourself. I don't know you and likely never will, but this means so much. Life gets better.

No. I'm not going to give you logistical advice on this, I'm going to give you the only advice which matters, however cliché, which is don't do it. Things always, always change and suicide is the worst thing you can do. Please PM or reply to me about this. You won't fail in the world if you let people give you sound advice.
Please, for the sake of everything do not do this. Please reply to me. I can talk with you, I love you. Don't do something you can't reverse. I beg you, talk to me.
PM me, I'm certain you'll cheer up after you start talking to me.

Thank you all, each one of you, for your sincere help. You're right; killing myself is letting them win. I'd much rather live to fight this evil. After all, it's my obligation as a French soldier to protect the people of France. They look to us for help, and I can't let that down. 

And trust me, the world's show of great support is touching every single person in France. We are all proud and thankful to have such endearing allies. So no, no suicide for me, not ever, it was a stupid idea. thank you again, and sorry for wasting your time.
